$comment: Machine lock for PDL diagnostics. Docs site generates Diagnostics from this file. Compiler still emits these codes; keep this table in lockstep when adding/retiring codes.

errors.name: unexpected-token
errors.trigger: The parser encountered a token it did not expect in the current context. Message MUST include the token and the production rule being parsed.

errors.name: circular-import
errors.trigger: An `import` chain forms a cycle. Message MUST include the full cycle path.

errors.name: duplicate-symbol
errors.trigger: Two top-level declarations share the same name within the same namespace (e.g. two `component Button` after merge).

errors.name: unknown-token-type
errors.trigger: A `primitive` or `semantic` declaration uses a `TokenType` name that is not in the §21.2 list.

errors.name: token-type-mismatch
errors.trigger: The RHS value of a token declaration is incompatible with the declared `TokenType` (§23.2).

errors.name: frame-prop-type-mismatch
errors.trigger: A frame property (or `typeStyle` prop) is assigned a value of the wrong type (§23.3 / `shared/frame-props.json`).

errors.name: unresolved-reference
errors.trigger: A dotted identifier or bare identifier used as a value does not match any token, parameter, or frame id in scope.

errors.name: unresolved-type-style
errors.trigger: A `style = Name` reference does not match any declared `typeStyle` (case-sensitive).
Formerly `interaction … for ComponentName`. The `interaction` keyword is removed (**PDL-E001**); do not emit E009 for new source.

errors.name: invalid-condition-operand
errors.trigger: A condition expression compares a non-variant parameter, or uses an operator not supported for its type (§23.5).

errors.name: unknown-frame-property
errors.trigger: A property name is used on a frame kind (or `typeStyle`) that does not define it (§5 / `shared/frame-props.json`).

errors.name: invalid-frame-prop-target
errors.trigger: Unknown frame id in a dotted assign (`Ghost.hidden = …`), a property used on the wrong frame kind (e.g. `hidden` on `text`), or a fixture body that illegally references another param (§23.6).

errors.name: circular-token-reference
errors.trigger: A token's RHS resolves to itself directly or through a chain.

errors.name: duplicate-fixture-label
errors.trigger: Two `example` blocks within the same `fixtures ComponentName { … }` have identical labels.
Formerly `expose-unknown-param`. **`expose` removed** from the language — do not emit.

errors.name: extend-unknown-target
errors.trigger: An `extend` block names a component that does not exist in the merged definition.

errors.name: quoted-hex-color
errors.trigger: A string literal is used where a `Color` value is expected and the string content matches the hex color pattern — hex colors must be unquoted.

errors.name: reserved-word-as-identifier
errors.trigger: A reserved word (§20.4) is used as a user-defined identifier.

errors.name: invalid-override-target
errors.trigger: A `children` frame-id ref or `FrameId.prop` / `FrameId.children` assignment names a frame that has not been declared with `let` / `letInstance` earlier in the component body (forward reference).

errors.name: invalid-constructor-arg
errors.trigger: Constructor / pack argument error: required kw missing, illegal combination (e.g. **`MediaLayer(…)` already has `opacity:` and also uses postfix `@`**), or pack schema violation. (Wrong *types* on known kwargs are often **PDL-E040**.)

errors.name: duplicate-let-frame-id
errors.trigger: Two **`let`** or **`letInstance`** frames in the same component reuse the same **`id`** (names must be unique across the whole component body, including all **`if`** branches and sibling nested frames).

errors.name: unknown-protocol
errors.trigger:
A `component C

` / `component C ` or protocol-typed param references an undeclared protocol.

errors.name: unknown-foreach-list
errors.trigger: `ForEach(name)` names a parameter that is not an expandable list/slot in the enclosing component (§4e).

errors.name: unknown-emit-channel
errors.trigger: Layout emit capture or `emit` names a channel not in the effective `emits` set for the relevant component/protocol (§4d–§4e).

errors.name: invalid-foreach-binding
errors.trigger: A derived bind inside `ForEach` references an unknown parent/item field or fails type rules for the target child param (§4e).

errors.name: foreach-chrome-unimplemented
errors.trigger: `before` / `between` / `after` appears in `ForEach` before B6 is implemented (implementations **MAY** use this code while rejecting chrome).

errors.name: emit-payload-mismatch
errors.trigger: Layout `channel(…) = { … }` arity or types do not match the effective emit signature by position, or a fire-site `emit` arg fails the declared payload type (§4d–§4e).

errors.name: ambient-as-emit-capture
errors.trigger: A host inbound channel name is used as a **child emit capture** (e.g. bare / parent-qualified `pressEnd(…) = { … }` without `self.`) (§4a′ / §8).

errors.name: declared-as-host-channel
errors.trigger: A declared emit channel name is used as a host inbound channel (`self.select = { … }`) (§8) — use parent layout handler assignment instead.

errors.name: interaction-missing-host-protocol
errors.trigger: A component wires a host channel / verb (`self.pressEnd`, `beginEditing`, …) without effective host protocol conformance (§4a / §4a′).

errors.name: host-protocol-as-slot-type
errors.trigger: A host-role protocol is used as a param or `[T]` slot/array element type (§4a).

errors.name: invalid-protocol-requires
errors.trigger: `requires` targets a non-host protocol, an unknown name, or appears on a host protocol (§4a).

errors.name: unknown-host-verb
errors.trigger: Interaction body calls an unknown host verb (expected `beginEditing` / `cancelEditing` / `commitEditing`) (§4a).

errors.name: array-slot-dotted-override
errors.trigger: `slots.field = …` on an **array** slot/list param; use `ForEach(slots) { item in item.field = … }` (§4b / §4e).

errors.name: foreach-without-mount
errors.trigger: `ForEach(list)` appears but `list` is never referenced in any `children = […]` / `children = list` of the component (§4e).

errors.name: list-emit-capture
errors.trigger: Emit capture qualifies an **array/list** param (`chips.select(…) = { … }`); use `ForEach(chips) { chip in chip.select(…) = { … } }` (§4e).

errors.name: unknown-component
errors.trigger: A companion block, instance, bake, or resolve path names a component that does not exist in the merged definition.

errors.name: mixed-condition-operators
errors.trigger: A condition expression mixes `&&` and `||` at the same precedence level without parentheses (§21.6).

errors.name: unknown-param-type
errors.trigger: A component / protocol / emit parameter uses a type name that is not a built-in (§23.1), declared `variant`, API protocol, or component. **`Boolean`** is rejected — use **`Bool`**.

errors.name: param-type-mismatch
errors.trigger: A parameter default, instance kwarg, or fixture binding is not type-compatible with the declared parameter type (§23.4 / §23.6).

errors.name: unknown-sample-path
errors.trigger: A `Bank.entry.field` sample path names an unknown bank, entry, or field; a path is sample-shaped but invalid; or a `samples` bank name collides with a component (§11a).

errors.name: duplicate-mount
errors.trigger: The same **`let`** / **`letInstance`** frame is mounted more than once (`children = [button, button]`, or the same id under two parents). A let is one object with one place in the tree; write two lets or a list.

errors.name: duplicate-protocol-header
errors.trigger: A component header lists the same protocol more than once (`component C <PointerInput, PointerInput>`).

errors.name: multiple-api-protocols
errors.trigger: A component header lists more than one API protocol (`component C <ModalContent, SubnavItem>`). Any number of host protocols is allowed; at most one API protocol in v1.

errors.name: host-param-shape-mismatch
errors.trigger: Two `host` profiles in the same design declare different param names or types. Defaults may differ; the `<Host>` contract must be one shape.

errors.name: unknown-host-profile
errors.trigger: Bake `--host` / `host` names a profile that is not in the design, or the design has several `host` profiles and none named `Default` and no profile was requested.

errors.name: host-probe-outside-mount
errors.trigger: `host["…"]` or `??` appears outside a `mount` body (component body, token RHS, or other value).

errors.name: mount-coalesce-empty
errors.trigger: A `mount` let or `self.param =` coalesce produced no value (every `as?` arm missed and there was no literal fallback), or a strict `as` convert failed.

errors.name: theme-catalog-role-mismatch
errors.trigger: `use catalog` names a `theme`, or bake `--theme` / the theme argument names a `catalog`. Themes are user-toggleable; catalogs are host-applied in `mount`.

errors.name: invalid-host-facts
errors.trigger: A fixture `hostFacts` value is not a JSON object string (invalid JSON, or a JSON array/scalar).

warnings.name: param-shadows-token
warnings.trigger: A component parameter name matches an existing token name; the parameter takes precedence inside the component body.

warnings.name: primitive-token-in-component
warnings.trigger: A component references a `primitive` token directly instead of a `semantic` token. Advisory only; valid in demos.

warnings.name: literal-opacity-in-library
warnings.trigger: A raw `0…1` numeric literal is used where an `Opacity` token would be more appropriate for a design-system library context.

warnings.name: unfixable-schemaVersion
warnings.trigger: The `schemaVersion` on a catalogue or manifest input is not a version this toolchain understands; output may be incomplete.

warnings.name: unknown-key-in-usage
warnings.trigger: A `usage` block contains a key other than `description`. The key is preserved but has no normative behavior in v1.

warnings.name: empty-component
warnings.trigger: A component's root frame has no children and no content properties set. Likely a stub.

warnings.name: unreachable-override-branch
warnings.trigger: A branch in an `if` / `else if` / `else` chain can never be reached because an earlier branch covers all cases of the variant.
Formerly `unknown-motion-prop` on `from` / `to` snapshot keys. Those blocks are removed; unknown `Pose(…)` labels are PDL-E005.
